Volunteer-run and community-minded Blessings to You Centre operates two retail stores and a dedicated donation depot in Palmerston, helping practical kindness move through the Minto community.
Palmerston, Ontario • Two stores + donation depot

Shop, donate, and help good move through the community.

Blessings to You Centre welcomes everyone to shop for affordable clothing, gifts, household items, books, toys, jewelry, and special finds while supporting local charities, families, youth programs, food banks, and community initiatives.

Store hours

Donation drop-offs

Bring clean, usable donations to the Donation Depot & Processing Centre during posted hours unless otherwise announced.

Current contact points

For shopping, donations, volunteering, and general questions, call or email the store team. Social updates continue on Facebook and Instagram.

Shop with purpose

Affordable finds with local impact.

The stores are volunteer-run and stocked by community generosity. Every purchase helps keep useful items in circulation while proceeds support local needs and meaningful initiatives.

Community impact

Local generosity, local results.

Blessings to You Centre supports schools, student nutrition, food banks, recreation, community organizations, and practical needs across Palmerston and the wider Minto area.

    Funding requests

    Thoughtful community disbursements.

    “We thoughtfully distribute funds to support meaningful needs and initiatives in the community of Minto, Ontario, in a fair and responsible way.”

    Community groups, organizations, and individuals can download the sponsorship application below. Completed applications or questions can be sent to the Disbursement Coordinator through the dedicated funding request email.

    Donate gently used goods

    Clear out clutter. Create good.

    Your clean, usable donations help stock the stores, supply special finds and silent auctions, and turn everyday items into meaningful support for the community.

    What to bring

    Donations accepted at the Donation Depot

    Please donate items that are clean, complete, and in good condition. If you are unsure about a large or unusual item, call first before bringing it in.

      Visit us

      Two stores and one donation depot on Main Street.

      Stop in to shop, donate, ask about volunteering, or learn more about how Blessings to You Centre supports the community.

      Volunteer with us

      Give a few hours. Make a practical difference.

      Volunteers help sort donations, prepare displays, serve customers, organize merchandise, support special projects, and keep the mission moving. Students completing required community service hours are welcome to apply.

      Contact & social

      Questions, donations, volunteering, or funding requests?

      For the fastest answer, call during store hours or send an email with your name, contact information, and what you need help with. Social channels remain the best place for news, featured items, and updates.

      Follow Blessings online

      Facebook and Instagram are the best places to see current updates, featured items, community news, and store activity.
